definitionZh: 混凝土-blend-mode CSS属性设定一个元素的内容应当如何与其背景融合——在同一堆叠上下文中元素背后的内容.
sourceDefinition: The mix-blend-mode CSS property sets how an element's content should blend with its backdrop — the content rendered behind the element within the same stacking context.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The mix-blend-mode CSS property sets how an element's content should blend with its backdrop — the content rendered behind the element within the same stacking context.
